subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill configuration action field, and what URL trust policy should the dashboard enforce for skill-authored configuration links?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but crosses a public skill metadata contract and dashboard URL trust boundary, so automation should not choose the permanent API or security policy.

options.title: Design a typed action contract first
options.body: Add a generic skill action/configuration metadata shape with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, dashboard rendering, docs, and tests.

options.title: Reuse homepage and Skill Cards only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document `homepage` or Skill Card content as the supported self-serve path until a broader plugin settings model exists.

options.title: Add narrow configUrl/configButton fields
options.body: Implement the proposed names directly, accepting the risk that they may become a parallel settings-link contract.

recommendation.title: Design a typed action contract first
recommendation.body: Add a generic skill action/configuration metadata shape with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, dashboard rendering, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to the current skill metadata, status, UI, and URL-safety surfaces that would carry the decision.
